s01_title.sentence: On-device quality control for steel and metal surfaces, on a Raspberry Pi five with a Hailo accelerator and Llama.

s02_problem.sentence: Plates leave the line with scratches, dents, pits, corrosion, cracks and stains.
Manual checks are slow and inconsistent, and cameras are fooled by glare.

s03_product.sentence: This is the handheld Aayas: a five-inch touch screen, a Raspberry Pi five with the AI HAT plus two and its Hailo ten-H, and the Raspberry Pi AI Camera between two pods of white and ultraviolet LEDs.
A clip-on hood with an LED ring shuts out daylight.

s04_burst.sentence: Each scan is a five frame burst: both LEDs, left, off, right, and both again.
The dark frame removes room light, left and right remove glare, and a quality gate refuses any capture it cannot trust.

s05_uv.sentence: An ultraviolet burst over a fluorescent penetrant will make cracks glow.
That is next on our roadmap.

s05b_flow.sentence: From scan to verdict: the burst is cleaned, rectified and tiled, the Hailo finds the defects, each one is measured and judged by the rules, dents get a three D depth, and Llama writes the note on screen, in about two seconds.

s06_detect.sentence: YOLO vee eight nano, with its backbone, feature pyramid and three detection heads, runs on the Hailo ten-H in forty seven milliseconds.

s07_rules.sentence: Each defect is matched to a rule from the steel standards, which sets its severity.
The worst one decides the verdict: pass, clean, rework, hold for Q A, or reject.

s08_3d.sentence: For dents and pits, a physics informed network proposes a height map, a light model renders what each LED would see, and the error against the camera corrects it until they match.
This dent is about a third of a millimetre deep.

s09_llama.sentence: Llama three point two, one B, quantised with SpinQuant, runs on the Pi with ExecuTorch and explains the likely cause and how to prevent it.

s09b_qa.sentence: Why goes to Llama, behind a guardrail that checks every number.
How to fix comes straight from the rules engine.
Shift summary covers the last fifty parts, and three D, acknowledge and a saved record complete the station.

s10_close.sentence: Fully offline, on a Raspberry Pi five.
